# Vegas Stronger

> > Vegas Stronger connects Las Vegas area residents with community resources, crisis support, and recovery services across Nevada.

Vegas Stronger serves the Las Vegas, North Las Vegas, and Henderson communities by providing centralized access to critical services including domestic violence resources, addiction support, emergency housing, and wellness activities through partnerships with organizations like SafeNest, The Shade Tree of Las Vegas, and S.A.F.E. House Inc.
